overview: The Promote, Prevent, Support Behavioral Health Commission heard a presentation on culturally competent behavioral health care, adopted its foundational mission, vision, and values statements, and approved its year-one goals. The commission also voted to establish subcommittees and adopted a bimonthly meeting schedule.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from its January 19 meeting.

items.title: Culturally Competent Connections to Care Assessment
items.summary: Consultant Andrianne Breton-Cabernet presented findings and community recommendations from multilingual behavioral health listening sessions.

items.title: Mission, Vision, and Values Statements
items.summary: The commission reviewed, modified, and approved its proposed mission, vision, and values statements.

items.title: Year-One Goals and Objectives
items.summary: The commission voted to adopt its year-one goals and objectives to be completed through June 2023.

items.title: Subcommittee Structure and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The commission voted to form working subcommittees led by commission members and open to community participation, and agreed to meet bimonthly starting May 4, 2022.

items.title: Asset Mapping Overview
items.summary: Penny Funaiole shared an example asset map detailing direct services, health promotion, and community outreach efforts managed by the health department.
